data.desc: Reynolds Consumer Products is a leading provider of household essentials designed to simplify daily life, so consumers can enjoy what matters most. Found in 95% of U.S. homes, the Company offers trusted solutions for cooking, serving, clean-up, and storage. Its portfolio features iconic brands like Reynolds and Hefty, along with store brand products tailored to retail partners. Reynolds holds the No. 1 or No. 2 market share in most of the categories it serves. Learn more at investors.reynoldsconsumerproducts.com.
